name: gameap-gameconfigeditor
description: Game server config editor - GameAP plugin frontend

scripts.pretypecheck:
node -e "const m=+require('typescript/package.json').version.split('.')[0]; if(m>6){console.error('
  typecheck: TypeScript '+m+'.x is installed, but vue-tsc needs 6.x.
  TS 7 dropped typescript/lib/tsc, which vue-tsc requires, so it exits with
  ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED. typescript is pinned to 6.0.3 for this reason;
  see 'TypeScript is held at 6.x' in the README build notes.
'); process.exit(1)}"
